description: This is a PHP source file defining an API class 'WorkShiftAPI' for managing work shift data within the OrangeHRM system. It implements CRUD operations, validation rules, and interacts with the work shift service and data models.

classes.name: WorkShiftAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for CRUD operations related to WorkShift entities, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting work shifts, with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of work shifts, supports sorting and pagination, returns a collection result with total count.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a single work shift by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new work shift using parameters from the request, saves to database, and returns the created model.

methods.name: setParamsToWorkShift
methods.description: Assigns request parameters to a WorkShift entity's properties.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing work shifts, mainly sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the ID parameter for fetching a single work shift.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing work shift identified by ID with new parameters, then saves.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a work shift, including ID and property constraints.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes work shifts based on provided IDs, after validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting multiple work shifts.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the name property, ensuring it is required, unique, and has maximum length.
